newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Glickman announces Moos retirement.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Glickman announces Moos retirement.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department Secretary Dan Glickman officially announced the resignation of Gene Moos as Under Secretary for Farm and Foreign Agricultural Services.
Glickman confirmed news of Moos' retirement released by an aide earlier in the day.

"I wish Gene all the best in his retirement," Glickman said in a statement. "When he told me that he judged the break between the two Clinton terms as a logical time to retire, I said I was going to miss his counsel and unfailing civility."
For the past four years, Moos, 71, was in charge of USDA's farm support programs and export programs.
